✅ C. drew

scenes.question: Emma is the ___ in the team.

Two weeks ago, Bill and his family went to Ha Long Bay. They went there by train. They stayed there for five days. They went on a boat trip and visited some caves. They also ate seafood. Bill bought some sweets for his friends. It was a wonderful trip!

Bill bought some sweets for his friends.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: Bill bought some sweets for his friends.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
Daisy will building a sandcastle next week.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: Daisy will build a sandcastle next week. (will + động từ nguyên thể → 'build')
→ Daisy sẽ xây lâu đài cát tuần sau.

scenes.question:
Look and choose True or False.
This is Big Ben. It is in Singapore.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Tháp đồng hồ Big Ben ở nước Anh.
This is Big Ben. It is in Singapore. → Đây là Tháp đồng hồ Big Ben. Nó ở Singapore.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
She sings songs every weekend.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ Cô ấy hát mỗi cuối tuần.

scenes.question: The Colosseum is in Italy.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
The Colosseum is in Italy. → Đấu trường La Mã ở Ý.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
Peter will feeding the chickens next Sunday.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: Peter will feed the chickens next Sunday. (will + động từ nguyên thể → 'feed')
→ Peter sẽ cho gà ăn Chủ nhật tuần sau.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Hi, I'm Ben. I'm nine years old and I'm in Class 4A. I live in Ho Chi Minh City with my family. My favourite subject is IT because I like using computers. I'm good at dancing. At the weekend, I usually visit my grandparents. I want to be a pilot in the future because I want to fly around the world.

Ben's favourite subject is IT.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: I live in Ho Chi Minh City with my family.

scenes.question: The capital of Brazil is Brasília.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
The capital of Brazil is Brasília. → Thủ đô của Bra-xin là Brasília.

scenes.question: Six times nine is fifty-three.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Six times nine is fifty-three. → 6 × 9 = 53.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
David collects stamps last Sunday.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: David collected stamps last Sunday. (có 'last Sunday' → quá khứ đơn: 'collected')
→ David đã sưu tầm tem Chủ nhật tuần trước.

scenes.question: Five times six is thirty.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
Five times six is thirty. → 5 × 6 = 30.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
She fed the chickens yesterday.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ Cô ấy đã cho gà ăn hôm qua.

scenes.question: Hoan Kiem Lake is in Singapore.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Hoan Kiem Lake is in Singapore. → Hồ Hoàn Kiếm ở Singapore.
👉 Hồ Hoàn Kiếm ở Việt Nam.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
She helps her mother last night.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: She helped her mother last night. (có 'last night' → quá khứ đơn: 'helped')
→ Cô ấy đã giúp mẹ tối qua.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
She runs in the park every morning.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ Cô ấy chạy trong công viên mỗi sáng.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Hi, I'm Bao. I'm nine years old and I'm in Class 4E. I live in Quang Ninh with my family. My favourite subject is History because I like learning about the past. I'm good at swimming. At the weekend, I usually go to the cinema. I want to be a teacher in the future because I like working with children.

Bao is eleven years old.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: I'm nine years old and I'm in Class 4E.
👉 Đáp án đúng: nine

scenes.question: The capital of Sweden is Beijing.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
The capital of Sweden is Beijing. → Thủ đô của Thụy Điển là Beijing.
👉 Thủ đô của Thụy Điển là Stockholm.

scenes.question:
Listen and choose True or False.
The speaker reads for an hour before bed.
scenes.hint:
🎧 Bài nghe: Every evening, my mum makes me a timetable. From six to seven, I do my homework. From seven to seven thirty, we have dinner. Then I can watch TV for half an hour. I go to bed at nine after reading a book for an hour.
✅ A. True
The speaker reads for an hour before bed. → Người nói đọc sách một tiếng.

scenes.question:
Listen and choose True or False.
Thuy worked on the project for two days.
scenes.hint:
🎧 Bài nghe: Kim: You look upset. What happened?
Thuy: I left my science project on the bus this morning. I worked on it for two weeks!
Kim: Don't worry. Call the bus company. They keep lost things in their office.
Thuy: Really? I'll call them now.
✅ B. False
👉 Thuy left her science project on the bus. → Thủy để quên dự án khoa học trên xe buýt.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Bill gets up at a quarter to six every morning. He brushes his teeth and has breakfast. Then he goes to school by motorbike with his father at seven o'clock. After school, he goes swimming. He has dinner with his family at seven o'clock and goes to bed at ten o'clock.

Bill goes to bed at half past eight.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: He has dinner with his family at seven o'clock and goes to bed at ten o'clock.
👉 Đáp án đúng: At ten o'clock.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Tim gets up at a quarter to six every morning. He brushes his teeth and has breakfast. Then he goes to school by bike at seven o'clock. After school, he helps his mother cook dinner. He has dinner with his family at seven o'clock and goes to bed at ten o'clock.

After school, Tim helps his mother cook dinner.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: After school, he helps his mother cook dinner.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
Lucy study Maths on Saturdays.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: Lucy studies Maths on Saturdays. (chủ ngữ 'Lucy' số ít, thì hiện tại đơn → 'studies')
→ Lucy học Toán vào các ngày thứ Bảy.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
Tim will tidying his room next week.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: Tim will tidy his room next week. (will + động từ nguyên thể → 'tidy')
→ Tim sẽ dọn phòng tuần sau.

scenes.question: The Petronas Towers is in Malaysia.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
The Petronas Towers is in Malaysia. → Tháp đôi Petronas ở Ma-lai-xi-a.

scenes.question: Fifty-six is an even number.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
Fifty-six is an even number. → 56 là số chẵn.

scenes.question: A lesson starts at 6:15 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 7:00.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
A lesson starts at 6:15 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 7:00. → Tiết học bắt đầu lúc 6:15, kéo dài 60 phút, kết thúc lúc 7:00.
👉 6:15 + 60 phút = 7:15

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
He is listening to music at the moment.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ Cậu ấy đang nghe nhạc lúc này.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Last summer, Trang and her family went to Nha Trang. They went there by car. They stayed there for five days. They swam in the sea and built sandcastles. They also ate seafood. Trang bought a toy boat for her friends. It was a wonderful trip!

Trang bought a toy boat for her friends.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: Trang bought a toy boat for her friends.

scenes.question: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in Japan.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
The Leaning Tower of Pisa is in Japan. → Tháp nghiêng Pisa ở Nhật Bản.
👉 Tháp nghiêng Pisa ở Ý.

scenes.question: Ninety-eight is an odd number.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Ninety-eight is an odd number. → 98 là số lẻ.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
David plays the guitar every morning.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ David chơi đàn ghi-ta mỗi sáng.

scenes.question:
Listen and choose True or False.
Five pupils come to school by school bus.
scenes.hint:
🎧 Bài nghe: There are thirty-five pupils in my class. Last week, our teacher asked us how we get to school. Twelve pupils walk, ten come by bike, eight come by motorbike with their parents, and the rest come by school bus.
✅ A. True
Five pupils come to school by school bus. → Có năm bạn đi học bằng xe buýt của trường.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
She climb trees on Saturdays.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: She climbs trees on Saturdays. (chủ ngữ 'She' số ít, thì hiện tại đơn → 'climbs')
→ Cô ấy trèo cây vào các ngày thứ Bảy.

scenes.question: "The Tale of Kieu" was written by Nguyen Du.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
"The Tale of Kieu" was written by Nguyen Du. → "Truyện Kiều" do Nguyen Du viết.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Hi, I'm Max. I'm nine years old and I'm in Class 4D. I live in Ho Chi Minh City with my family. My favourite subject is Maths because I like numbers. I'm good at cooking. At the weekend, I usually visit my grandparents. I want to be an architect in the future because I like designing houses.

Max lives in Ho Chi Minh City.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: I live in Ho Chi Minh City with my family.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Hi, I'm Lily. I'm ten years old and I'm in Class 4A. I live in Ha Noi with my family. My favourite subject is Vietnamese because I love reading stories. I'm good at dancing. At the weekend, I usually play football with my friends. I want to be a teacher in the future because I like working with children.

Lily is good at playing chess.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: I'm good at dancing.
👉 Đáp án đúng: dancing

scenes.question: Twenty-one divided by seven is three.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
Twenty-one divided by seven is three. → 21 : 7 = 3.

scenes.question: Halloween is on 25th December.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Halloween is on 25th December. → Lễ hội Halloween vào ngày 25 tháng 12.
👉 Lễ hội Halloween: ngày 31 tháng 10

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Two weeks ago, Peter and his family went to Sa Pa. They went there by train. They stayed there for four days. They climbed mountains and visited a village. They also ate grilled corn. Peter bought some sweets for his friends. It was a wonderful trip!

Peter's family went there by car.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: They went there by train.
👉 Đáp án đúng: by train

scenes.question:
Listen and choose True or False.
Mia will probably get a dictionary in the library.
scenes.hint:
🎧 Bài nghe: Mia: Can you lend me your dictionary, Quan?
Quan: Sorry, I lent it to Huong yesterday, and she hasn't given it back. Why don't you ask Ms Vy? There are some dictionaries in the library.
Mia: Good idea. Thanks.
✅ A. True
Mia will probably get a dictionary in the library. → Mia có lẽ sẽ mượn từ điển ở thư viện.

scenes.question: A lesson starts at 8:00 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 9:00.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
A lesson starts at 8:00 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 9:00. → Tiết học bắt đầu lúc 8:00, kéo dài 60 phút, kết thúc lúc 9:00.

scenes.question: Thirteen is an even number.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Thirteen is an even number. → 13 là số chẵn.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
You are having lunch right now.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
→ Bạn đang ăn trưa ngay bây giờ.

scenes.question: If today is Tuesday, the day after tomorrow is Thursday.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
If today is Tuesday, the day after tomorrow is Thursday. → Nếu hôm nay là thứ Ba thì ngày kia là thứ Năm.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "autumn"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (autumn → mùa thu)
👉 Tách âm tiết: au-tumn

scenes.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?
choices: A. We often get to the island by car and ferry.
B. He will sing songs next Sunday.
C. Nga goes to bed last night.
D. We listened to music yesterday morning.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ C. Nga goes to bed last night.
👉 Câu đúng: Nga went to bed last night.

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: A. We are reading comics now.
C. We is reading comics now.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ A. We are reading comics now.

scenes.question:
Put the words in the correct order.
Tim / Max / older / is / than
choices: A. Older is Max than Tim.
B. Max is Tim than older.
C. Max than older is Tim.
D. Max is older than Tim.
scenes.hint:
Sắp xếp theo trật tự câu: Chủ ngữ + động từ + tân ngữ/bổ ngữ + trạng ngữ (nơi chốn, thời gian).
✅ D. Max is older than Tim.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "mountains"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (mountains → những ngọn núi)
👉 Tách âm tiết: moun-tains

scenes.question: Nick ___ to bed last night.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ D. went
👉 Nick went to bed last night.

scenes.question: I ___ my room at the moment.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ A. am tidying
👉 I am tidying my room at the moment.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
My father will draw pictures <u>next week</u>.
choices: A. Why will your father draw pictures?
B. How will your father draw pictures?
C. When will your father draw pictures?
D. Where will your father draw pictures?
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ C. When will your father draw pictures?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'next week' → hỏi thời gian: ngày, tuần, tháng… (When).

scenes.question: Is the cinema more crowded than the library?
scenes.hint:
Trả lời ngắn phải dùng đúng trợ động từ của câu hỏi (Is) và đúng đại từ.
✅ A. Yes, it is.

scenes.question: Hung is ___ than Kate.
scenes.hint:
So sánh hơn: tính từ ngắn + -er + than; tính từ dài: more + adj + than; bất quy tắc: good → better, bad → worse. Không dùng 'more' với tính từ đã thêm -er.
✅ C. younger
👉 Hung is younger than Kate.

scenes.question: Is the shoe on the green box?
scenes.hint:
Trả lời ngắn phải dùng đúng trợ động từ của câu hỏi (Is) và đúng đại từ.
✅ C. No, it isn't.

scenes.question: Where's the shopping mall?
choices: A. I have it on Fridays.
scenes.hint:
Câu hỏi hỏi nơi chốn (Where) → chọn câu trả lời đúng loại thông tin.
✅ B. It's opposite the school.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
She will collect stamps <u>tonight</u>.
choices: A. How will she collect stamps?
B. Where will she collect stamps?
C. When will she collect stamps?
D. Why will she collect stamps?
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ C. When will she collect stamps?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'tonight' → hỏi thời gian: ngày, tuần, tháng… (When).

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: A. I did take photos next Sunday.
B. I was taking photos next Sunday.
C. I will take photos next Sunday.
D. I took photos next Sunday.
scenes.hint:
Có tomorrow, next… → thì tương lai đơn: will + V nguyên thể.
✅ C. I will take photos next Sunday.

scenes.question: I'm going to go ___ the beach.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ B. to
👉 I'm going to go to the beach.

scenes.question: Is your sister making a cake?
scenes.hint:
Trả lời ngắn phải dùng đúng trợ động từ của câu hỏi (Is) và đúng đại từ.
✅ D. Yes, she is.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. bowls
👉 'ow' trong bowls đọc /əʊ/; trong down, town, brown đọc /aʊ/.

scenes.question: How does Leo get to his grandparents' house?
choices: B. He goes there by bus.
C. We were at the campsite.
D. I have PE twice a week.
scenes.hint:
Câu hỏi hỏi phương tiện/cách thức (How) → chọn câu trả lời đúng loại thông tin.
✅ B. He goes there by bus.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ D. helped
👉 Đuôi -ed trong helped đọc /t/; trong listened, used, watered đọc /d/.

scenes.question: There is ___ police station near my house.
scenes.hint:
Dùng 'an' trước từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm (a, e, i, o, u); dùng 'a' trước phụ âm. 'police' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm → a police.
✅ D. a
👉 There is a police station near my house.

scenes.question: Choose the correct spelling.
scenes.hint:
Cách viết đúng: sandwich (bánh mì kẹp).
✅ A. sandwich

scenes.question:
Put the words in the correct order.
the / is / in / Long / team / strongest / the
choices: A. Long is the the in strongest team.
B. Long is the strongest the in team.
C. Team is the strongest in the Long.
D. Long is the strongest in the team.
scenes.hint:
Sắp xếp theo trật tự câu: Chủ ngữ + động từ + tân ngữ/bổ ngữ + trạng ngữ (nơi chốn, thời gian).
✅ D. Long is the strongest in the team.

scenes.question: Lan has short black hair and ___ small nose.
scenes.hint:
Dùng 'an' trước từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm (a, e, i, o, u); dùng 'a' trước phụ âm. 'small' bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm → a small.
✅ B. a
👉 Lan has short black hair and a small nose.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "coat"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ A. one → 1 âm tiết (coat → áo choàng)

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ C. November
👉 'November' thuộc nhóm tháng; các từ còn lại (cherry, pear, watermelon) thuộc nhóm trái cây.
📖 Nghĩa: cherry (quả anh đào); watermelon (quả dưa hấu); November (tháng 11); pear (quả lê)

scenes.question:
Put the words in the correct order.
my / family / is / tallest / in / the / Phong
choices: A. Phong is the tallest in my family.
B. Phong is the family in my tallest.
C. Phong is the in tallest my family.
D. Phong is in tallest the my family.
scenes.hint:
Sắp xếp theo trật tự câu: Chủ ngữ + động từ + tân ngữ/bổ ngữ + trạng ngữ (nơi chốn, thời gian).
✅ A. Phong is the tallest in my family.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
✅ D. ice → đá lạnh
👉 'i' trong ice đọc /aɪ/; trong pick, fridge, six đọc /ɪ/.

scenes.question: Rosy is ___ than Peter.
scenes.hint:
So sánh hơn: tính từ ngắn + -er + than; tính từ dài: more + adj + than; bất quy tắc: good → better, bad → worse. Không dùng 'more' với tính từ đã thêm -er.
✅ C. taller
👉 Rosy is taller than Peter.

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. hot
👉 'hot' thuộc nhóm thời tiết; các từ còn lại (salad, sausage, bread) thuộc nhóm món ăn.
📖 Nghĩa: hot (trời nóng); sausage (xúc xích); bread (bánh mì); salad (xa lát)

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ A. maps
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong maps đọc /s/; trong arrives, cleans, schools đọc /z/.

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. bike → xe đạp
👉 'bike' thuộc nhóm phương tiện giao thông; các từ còn lại (lamp, wardrobe, cupboard) thuộc nhóm đồ đạc trong nhà.
📖 Nghĩa: cupboard (tủ chạn); bike (xe đạp); lamp (đèn); wardrobe (tủ quần áo)

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.

scenes.question: Long is the ___ in the team.

👉 Long is the strongest in the team.

scenes.question: He watched TV two ___ ago.

scenes.question: Phong is the ___ in my family.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.

scenes.question:

scenes.hint:

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.

Nước đóng băng rơi từ trời xuống là tuyết (snow).
✅ B. Snow

scenes.question: Where do we borrow books?
scenes.hint:
Chúng ta mượn sách ở thư viện (library).
✅ D. In a library

scenes.question: Which food is a dairy product?
scenes.hint:
Phô mai (cheese) làm từ sữa.
✅ B. Cheese

scenes.question: How many minutes are there in an hour?
scenes.hint:
Một giờ có 60 phút.
✅ B. Sixty

scenes.question: What is the opposite of 'big'?
scenes.hint:
Trái nghĩa của big (to) là small (nhỏ).
✅ A. Small

scenes.question: What is the opposite of 'light' (not heavy)?
scenes.hint:
Trái nghĩa của light (nhẹ) là heavy (nặng).
✅ D. Heavy

scenes.question: Which country has the biggest part of the Amazon rainforest?
scenes.hint:
Brazil có phần lớn rừng nhiệt đới Amazon.
✅ A. Brazil

scenes.question: Which day comes before Sunday?
scenes.hint:
Trước Chủ nhật là thứ Bảy.
✅ B. Saturday

scenes.question: Which meal do we have in the morning?
scenes.hint:
Bữa sáng là breakfast.
✅ C. Breakfast

scenes.question: What is the capital of Egypt?
scenes.hint:
Thủ đô Ai Cập là Cairo.
✅ D. Cairo

scenes.question: Which animal lays eggs?
scenes.hint:
Cá sấu (crocodile) đẻ trứng; chó, bò, ngựa đẻ con.
✅ A. Crocodile

scenes.question: Which sport do we play in water?
scenes.hint:
Bơi lội (swimming) diễn ra dưới nước.
✅ A. Swimming

scenes.question: What is the currency of Japan?
scenes.hint:
Tiền Nhật Bản là yên (yen).
✅ D. Yen

scenes.question: What is the currency of Viet Nam?
scenes.hint:
Tiền Việt Nam là đồng (dong).
✅ D. Dong

scenes.question: What do we wear when it rains?
scenes.hint:
Mưa thì mặc áo mưa (raincoat).
✅ B. A raincoat

scenes.question: In which country can you see the Taj Mahal?
scenes.hint:
Taj Mahal ở Ấn Độ.
✅ C. India

scenes.question: Which word is a verb?
scenes.hint:
Swim (bơi) là động từ.
✅ D. Swim

scenes.question: Which button do you press to turn on a computer?
scenes.hint:
Nút nguồn (power button) bật máy tính.
✅ A. The power button

scenes.question: Which country is famous for pandas?
scenes.hint:
Gấu trúc (panda) là biểu tượng của Trung Quốc.
✅ B. China

scenes.question: Who was the first man to travel into space?
scenes.hint:
Yuri Gagarin là người đầu tiên bay vào vũ trụ (1961).
✅ B. Yuri Gagarin

scenes.question: What is the shape of a ball?
scenes.hint:
Quả bóng có dạng hình cầu (sphere).
✅ B. A sphere

scenes.question: Which famous mausoleum is in Ha Noi?
scenes.hint:
Lăng Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh ở Hà Nội.
✅ B. Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum

scenes.question: Which sisters fought against the Han invaders in 40 AD?
scenes.hint:
Hai Bà Trưng khởi nghĩa năm 40.
✅ A. The Trung sisters

scenes.question: Ha Long Bay is famous for its ___.
scenes.hint:
Vịnh Hạ Long nổi tiếng với các đảo đá vôi.
✅ B. limestone islands
